title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Century Center, South Bend | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Century Center in South Bend, Indiana, USA, on 2 September 2018.

The show was to have taken place at the Morris Performing Arts Center, but the venue was changed after a piece of decorative plaster fell from the ceiling just days before.

Thank you South Bend what a night we had change of venue easy peace and love. ???????????????? pic.twitter.com/NTGK0Ejy0H

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) September 10, 2018

It was the 30th show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
